description: What it does AI Fruit is a video generator built specifically for viral fruit content. Pick a format — ASMR glass-fruit cutting, surreal fruit fusion, or a talking-fruit dialogue scene — describe your idea or drop in an image, and it generates a finished vertical short in seconds with frame-synced ASMR audio, automatic lip-sync, and ready-to-post 9:16 framing. Key benefits - Three signature formats: ASMR cutting, surreal fusion, talking-fruit dialogue - Multi-model engine: Google Veo 3.1, Kling
